input.quote: EXCEPT FOR LIABILITY ARISING UNDER SECTION 8 OF THIS AGREEMENT, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT OR THE USE OR PERFORMANCE OF THE SOFTWARE EXCEED THE TOTAL AMOUNT ACTUALLY PAID BY CORIO HEREUNDER FOR THE TRANSACTION WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES TO DURING THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO THE FILING OF THE CAUSE OF ACTION TO WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES.
input.rationale: Section 9 is nominally mutual and excludes consequential damages mutually, and Section 8 (Commerce One's IP infringement indemnity) sits outside the cap. However the cap basis deviates from the playbook: it is limited to amounts "ACTUALLY PAID" by Corio and only for "THE TRANSACTION WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES TO", so it is neither an aggregate 12-month fees cap nor subject to the USD 1,000,000 floor, and it is illusory where little has yet been paid for the specific transaction (e.g. early-term or revenue-share fees under Exhibit B). Carve-outs are also incomplete: only Section 8 indemnity is excluded, with nothing for confidentiality (Section 10), data/security, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud or infringement of the other party's IP, and Corio's fee payment obligations are not carved out of the cap/damages concept. Redline changes the basis to the greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and US$1,000,000 on an aggregate basis and adds a single "Excluded Claims" sentence, leaving the mutual consequential-damages exclusion untouched.

ops.oldText: EXCEPT FOR LIABILITY ARISING UNDER SECTION 8 OF THIS AGREEMENT, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF THIS AGREEMENT OR THE USE OR PERFORMANCE OF THE SOFTWARE EXCEED THE TOTAL AMOUNT ACTUALLY PAID BY CORIO HEREUNDER FOR THE TRANSACTION WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES TO DURING THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRIOR TO THE FILING OF THE CAUSE OF ACTION TO WHICH THE LIABILITY RELATES.
ops.newText: EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT OR THE USE OR PERFORMANCE OF THE SOFTWARE EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE BY CORIO UNDER THIS AGREEMENT IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (B) ONE MILLION U.S. DOLLARS (US$1,000,000). "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY, DATA PROTECTION OR SECURITY OBLIGATIONS, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS UNDER SECTION 8, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, AND ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS. CORIO'S OBLIGATION TO PAY FEES DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT BE SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION AND SHALL NOT CONSTITUTE DAMAGES FOR PURPOSES OF THIS SECTION 9.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have set the cap at the greater of twelve (12) months' fees paid or payable and US$1,000,000, applied to aggregate liability under the Agreement rather than only the amount actually paid for the single "transaction" at issue, which would make the cap illusory for most claims. We have also confirmed that indemnification, confidentiality/data security, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement sit outside the cap, and that Corio's fee payment obligations are not capped damages; a mutual 12-month fees cap with at least indemnity, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct carve-outs is our fallback.
proposal.summary: Make cap the greater of 12 months' fees paid or payable and US$1,000,000 on an aggregate basis, and add standard uncapped Excluded Claims.
